From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MAP playbook & kickoff assets - Acme

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As promised, I’m sharing a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) template and a starter slide deck so we can align on scope and milestones before the kickoff. I’ve attached a Google Doc draft (MAP_Template_Playbook_v1.gdoc) and a small slide pack for the kickoff.

Quick ask: could you send over the primary stakeholders and any procurement constraints (PO process / legal lead) you want on the MAP by EOD Tuesday? We’ll use that to tailor owners and acceptance criteria.

Proposed 30-day close timeline (high-level):
- Week 0: kickoff + environment access (technical contact, sample dataset)
- Week 1–2: integration & smoke tests (dev + infra)
- Week 3: evaluation (end-to-end checks, perf sampling)
- Week 4: acceptance, procurement signoff, and go/no-go

I added Marissa (CS) in CC to help capture acceptance criteria and success metrics in the MAP doc.

Attachments: MAP_Template_Playbook_v1.gdoc (link), Redwood-Acme-kickoff-slides.pptx (attachment)

Next steps: if that timeline looks right, I’ll turn the GDoc into a collaborative MAP and add owners.

Thanks,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Katie Lin <katie.lin@acme.io>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP playbook & kickoff assets - Acme

Sergio —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. The proposed timeline looks sensible. A couple of calls-outs from our side:

- Stakeholders: Katie (CTO), me (Dir. Product), and Jordan Smith (Security). I’ll confirm Jordan’s availability for the kickoff.
- Procurement: we need to route anything >$50k via our central procurement team — that adds an expected 7–10 business days after final SOW.
- Data access: we can provide a small anonymized dataset for the smoke tests; security will require an IP allowlist and an NDA amendment.

Can you add a short milestone to capture the procurement buffer so our PMs don’t assume immediate procurement signoff? Also please note Jordan (security) as a reviewer for the data-handling acceptance criteria.

Thanks — I’ll loop Jordan once you share the collaborative doc.

—Alex
Alex Turner
Director, Product Management | Acme Inc
alex.turner@acme.io

- Security reviewer: Jordan Smith is now listed under stakeholders-to-include for data acceptance gates.

I’ve turned the doc into a collaborative GDoc (link below) and added owners for the technical checklist so we can capture access tasks during the kickoff. Please confirm the stakeholder emails I have for Katie (katie.lin@acme.io) and Jordan (j.smith@acme.io).

GDoc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ExampleMapDocLink
Attachments: stakeholder-roster.xlsx (attachment)

If that looks good, can we schedule a 30-minute kickoff this Thursday at 10:00am PT? I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

- Success metrics: added 3 quant metrics (latency SLA, token cost per query, end-to-end accuracy checks).
